meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo-senpi. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo input hook injects the full directive as a hidden custom message (customType omo-ultrawork:directive, display false) ahead of the user's text, which is left untouched; a prompt queued while the agent is streaming instead carries the directive appended inside that same message. The directive is present in the conversation context; on the idle path it is not shown in the visible prompt, while a queued prompt carries the directive visibly (exactly as before this change). When the directive is already present in the conversation, do not read this file again - this file is that same directive. Read this file only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already present in the conversation.

howto.what: 当您的输入包含“ultrawork”或“ulw”时，Claude 会进入专业编码模式，按照严格流程提供经过验证的代码，并附上测试证据。
howto.when: 当您的话语中含有“ultrawork”或缩写“ulw”时触发。

say.text: 启动ultrawork模式，帮我写一个REST API端点。
say.note: Claude将按照严格流程创建并验证该端点。

say.text: 使用ulw模式，为这个模块添加单元测试。
say.note: Claude会先写失败测试，再实现代码通过测试。

say.text: 以ultrawork模式审查以下代码并给出改进。
say.note: Claude会基于证据驱动原则分析代码。

howto.what_en: When your input contains "ultrawork" or "ulw", Claude enters an expert coding mode, delivering verified code with test evidence following a strict workflow.
howto.when_en: Triggered when your message contains "ultrawork" or the abbreviation "ulw".

say_en.text: Start ultrawork mode and help me write a REST API endpoint.
say_en.note: Claude will create and verify the endpoint per strict process.

say_en.text: Use ulw mode to add unit tests for this module.
say_en.note: Claude writes failing tests first, then implements passing code.

say_en.text: In ultrawork mode, review the following code and suggest improvements.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes code based on evidence-driven principles.
